title: Nonconvex Sublevel Sets For The Planar Translating Mean Curvature Equation
summary: Translating solitons arise as models for type~II singularities of mean-convex mean curvature flow. We construct a smooth bounded uniformly convex domain \(\Om\Subset\R^2\) such that the zero-Dirichlet solution of the planar translating mean curvature equation has a nonconvex sublevel set. The construction is based on a corrected near-critical grim-reaper profile and explicit barriers on a long convex channel.
